description: This script provides utility functions for extracting and manipulating calibration data, primarily for firmware or device configuration in an embedded Linux environment, such as OpenWrt. It includes functions to read calibration data from different media, verify data validity, patch data, and modify MAC addresses.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a low-level block data transfer using dd with parameters for source, target, count, and offset.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script execution.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a specified partition identified by name.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume in NAND flash.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Reads a segment of data in reverse byte order and writes it to firmware.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a source file to the firmware location.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data into sysfs, indicating loading status.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Checks if the calibration data starts with the expected magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_data
methods.description: Patches specific data or checksum segments within firmware.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches the MAC address in firmware data for ath9k devices.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches the MAC and associated checksum for ath9k firmware.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches the MAC address for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches the MAC address for ath11k devices with an ID.

methods.name: ath10k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain information from firmware for ath10k.

methods.name: ath11k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain data from firmware for ath11k.

methods.name: ath11k_set_macflag
methods.description: Sets a MAC flag in firmware for ath11k devices.
